replaces: global-ratio stride with implicit size (which produced 1316, then 72 with 7 silent documents); the ratio mechanism is superseded, the stride mechanism is kept
assumption_requiring_confirmation: The stage-1 base sentence per document is NOT drawn from a designated section; it is folded into the document budget, which is then allocated across the document sections proportionally. If a designated origin for the base sentence is wanted instead, this freeze must be revised before building.
stage1: every one of the 23 selected documents receives 1 sentence; no qualified document can vanish by rounding

stage2.distribution: the remaining 177 sentences are distributed across the 23 documents proportionally to their audited section counts
stage2.method: Largest Remainder (Hamilton): ideal quota, integer floor, remaining seats by largest fractional remainder
stage2.tie_break: deterministic; frozen document order as listed in selected_documents of docs/batch7_fetch_log_v1.json

within_document.distribution: each document budget is distributed across its own sections proportionally to usable sentences per section
within_document.method: Largest Remainder (Hamilton) with deterministic tie-break by section order in document order
within_document.picks: within each section, the frozen even-stride mechanism takes the first k picks of that section quota

degenerate: transport_k1_kytc_acfr keeps its single section and contributes its budget through the document-wide stride; marked DEGENERATE, otherwise a normal contribution
forbidden: any implicit minimum per section or document beyond the explicit stage-1 base

audit.note: usable counts recomputed under the builder text definition differ slightly from the qualification counts (same documents, same verdicts, all >= 300); quotas use section structure, not either count, so the difference does not enter the allocation

downstream: one production build under exactly this rule, then digest pin; N=80 only from pipeline records afterwards
